carrier_state.SHOKAKU_ZUIKAKU_HIRYU_SORYU: A / veteran first-line deck-cycle system; hull/deck fully battle-usable on 14 Jun.
carrier_state.TAIHO: A-/A. Fully included in normal first coordinated cycle. Repeat-cycle/night/adverse-weather/damage-recovery remains slightly below the veteran four but no longer just a work-up deck.

five_carrier_core.role_mix_guard: Working-center counts are composition bookkeeping inside the 358-380 ready band, not extra aircraft. Actual launch package varies by search/CAP allocation and deck state.
five_carrier_core.fighter_quality_note: Kinsei Zero materially narrows the speed/energy deficit and gives better disengagement/escort choices versus F6F, but F6F protection, high-speed handling, radar-CIC fighter direction and numerical depth remain major US advantages.
five_carrier_core.A7M: COMBAT 0. Reppu is still prototype/test and is not embarked for this battle.

secondary_carrier_group.employment: Separate second echelon: CAP, search, reserve/second strike and convoy/surface-cover support. It is not merged into the first five-carrier synchronized launch because ship speed, deck cycle and air-group median remain heterogeneous.

construction_nonparticipants.UNRYU_AMAGI: Not yet combat-ready; completion/work-up clocks remain future.
construction_nonparticipants.CHITOSE_CHIYODA: Remain seaplane tenders under branch policy; do not count them as carriers.
construction_nonparticipants.SHINANO: Not converted into a carrier under current branch policy.
